## What landed (implementation)

- `web/src/lib/typeahead-shards.ts` — the ONE shard catalog + builder.
  Named things only (K3 §2.4 sets A/C — places from the grouped dossier
  index with level·records·parent detail + subject_label/code alternates,
  source registry rows, declared technology labels; records never enter;
  organisations join when `/entity/` ships — R-6 never links a missing
  page). Word-start keys (first two alnum chars of every label/alternate
  word), the K3 `at`/`de`/`&` stop words, deterministic output, a
  three-character split for buckets past ~24 KiB (the two-char shard keeps
  a bounded representative set marked `deeper`), and a hard build failure
  past the ratified ≤ 50 KiB shard bound (SIG-ENG-042, never smoothed).
- `web/src/pages/search/shards/[key].json.ts` — emits every shard at
  `/search/shards/<key>.json`; `TYPEAHEAD_SHARD_ROOT` is the single root
  constant every consumer names.
- `web/src/elements/typeahead-model.ts` — `detail`/`alt` entry fields and
  the `deeper` shard flag; `matchEntries` scores alternates (a typed
  "OKC" still surfaces "Oklahoma City").
- `web/src/elements/sig-typeahead.ts` — the P36.20 shell extended: the
  `deeper` three-char refetch, the detail line, and SSR-safe module shape
  (`HTMLElement` stand-in) so any island bundle may register the element.
- Header element (`SiteHeader.astro` + `BaseLayout.astro`): the plain GET
  form upgrades to the APG combobox — T1 full-chrome pages load the
  allow-listed `/_kit/sig-typeahead.js` module beside the markup; T2
  routes mount the markup script-free (a `/_kit/` src fails the T2 script
  policy — on `/search/` the island's own `/_astro/` bundle registers the
  element, on `/map/`/`/network/` the form stays its complete GET self);
  T0 and unclassified routes never carry the element.
- Consumers: the home `/` hero place-search form and the `/dossier/`
  index place form (the native `<datalist>` stays the no-JS suggestion
  path) wrap the same shard root; the `/search/` corpus GET form mounts
  it via the island bundle. The map place search (P37.19) and explorer
  search-to-node (P37.26) read the same set when their rows land.
- `/search/` rewrite: `SearchIsland` migrated React → Preact (SIG-UI-097;
  absorbs UXK0-6 for this surface). Mount is `client:only="preact"` with a
  static reserved box in the page markup — a `.tsx` island resolves to
  BOTH installed renderers and Astro's SSR check is ambiguous while
  `@astrojs/react` coexists for `/network/` (GX-09a removes it; the
  P36.37 map precedent). Preact semantics: `onInput` per keystroke (the
  DOM `change` event fires on commit, not per character — caught by the
  islands e2e). The ≈ 66 KiB React runtime is gone from `/search/`:
  `jsInitialBytes` measures under the ratified 61,440 B and the stale-row
  gate forced the `measured_gaps` row's removal; `lighthouserc*.json`
  regenerated. `check-runtime-deps` now asserts the /search/ bundle
  React-free; `runtime-deps.json`'s transitional note narrows to
  /network/.
